name: Files
description: Browse, search, read and (optionally) edit files in your workspace.

permissions.reason: Read files in the current workspace to answer questions about them.
Create and edit files in the workspace when you ask it to. Without this, Files is read-only.

tools.name: list_dir
tools.title: List folder
tools.description: List files and folders (with sizes) under a path in the workspace. Use depth>1 for a tree.

tools.name: read_file
tools.title: Read file
tools.description: Read a text file with line numbers. Optionally pass startLine/endLine (1-based, inclusive) for large files.

tools.name: search_text
tools.title: Search text
tools.description: Search file contents in the workspace for a string or regular expression. Returns file:line matches.

tools.name: write_file
tools.title: Write file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a text file in the workspace with the given content.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.title: Edit file
tools.description: Replace an exact snippet of text in a file. 'find' must match exactly once unless all=true.

ignore.description: File or folder names skipped by list_dir and search_text.

maxFiles.description: Maximum files visited by one search.

maxFileKb.description: Files larger than this are skipped by search and truncated by read.
